caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden tankard or mug with a hinged lid. The body of the tankard is barrel-shaped, constructed of vertical brown staves with visible grain texture. These staves are held together by several horizontal greenish-yellow bands or hoops that wrap around the tankard’s circumference. The handle, attached to the side, is also wooden and curves outward before turning back in towards the tankard. The hinged lid, in the open position, is attached to the top of the handle and matches the wood and color of the rest of the object. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. At the lower right side of the tankard, a small, cursive signature is visible.
title: Wine Jug
